cwe_content.cwe: CWE-601,URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

candidate.Reason: The absolute URL pattern regex '[a-z0-9]+:' only matches URLs with explicit schemes (like 'http:', 'https:'), allowing bypass with protocol-relative URLs like '//mydomain.com' or malformed URLs like 'http:/mydomain.com' that don't match the pattern but are still valid redirect targets

candidate.Code: private static final Pattern ABSOLUTE_URL_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("[a-z0-9]+:");
candidate.Reason: The regex pattern '[a-z0-9]+:' is insufficient to detect all absolute URLs, missing protocol-relative URLs (starting with '//') and incorrectly formatted URLs, allowing open redirect bypass
